summary: Emit governance remediation proposals for Koru

delivery.outcome: Goal emits a strict, deduplicated governance remediation proposal and delegates it through the Koru CLI while preserving the original fail-closed result.
nonGoals: Do not import Koru or Planfile as a Goal runtime dependency
Do not create a ticket for diagnostics absent from the target catalog
Do not swallow or downgrade a governance failure
Do not execute, push, merge, tag or publish remediation work

architecture.decision: Keep Goal as a protocol producer. Write a canonical proposal under .planfile/.koru/goal-remediation and invoke the Koru consumer through an argument-vector subprocess boundary; preserve the original ClickException after best-effort delegation.
architecture.rollback: Disable the producer hook and remove the Koru delegation call while retaining the existing governance gate.

commands: python -m ruff check goal/governance/delivery.py goal/governance/remediation.py tests/test_governance_remediation.py tests/test_governance_delivery.py
validation.evidence: Focused producer and existing delivery checks plus managed repository gates
